scientific_integrity: Theorems established by rational-function invariance and divisor analysis; finite enumerations corroborate but do not prove infinite assertions; no claim of global research priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless polynomial setting, lines through their intersection, no noise stability or optimal finite-sample complexity proved; potential prior equivalent multiplicity census not excluded by all literature.
title: Exact polynomial phase-retrieval fibers on two rational-angle lines
